name: 08054 · Mount Laurel, NJ
findings: ZIP 08054 (Mount Laurel) has 231 nonprofit organizations. 136 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 119 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08054 (Mount Laurel) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
